app.name: tScore
app.tagline: Artisanally AI-crafted by trials nerds, for trials nerds.
app.licence: Free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.

comingSoon: Coming in a later version of tScore

home.tidyOld_one: 1 event is over a month old and uses {{size}}.
home.tidyOld_other: {{count}} events are over a month old and use {{size}}.
home.none: No events yet. Start with New event; it takes a couple of minutes.
home.offline: Works offline. New events are saved in {{folder}}.

setup.title: Event setup
setup.intro: Everything else (labels, scanning, results) follows from this page. Boxes marked <mark/> must be filled in.
setup.name: Event name
setup.codeHelp: Goes in each label's QR code
setup.lowHelp: Ties are split by most cleans, then most 1s, 2s and 3s, then fewest 5s
setup.overdueHelp: A rider is overdue this long past their class's average lap. Overdue never marks anyone DNF.
setup.total: Total: {{labels}} labels for {{riders}} riders. Changes after scanning starts are allowed, and logged.
setup.ridersLater: Riders are added after setup. Set laps to 0 for a class that is not scored, such as minders.

backup.title: Saving and backup
backup.savedAsYouGo: Saved as each change is made. Nothing to set.
backup.autoHelp: A backup is made within five minutes of a change, and when the event closes. The newest 20 are kept in the event's backups folder ({{count}} there now{{last}}).
backup.secondTo: Every backup is also copied to {{place}}.
backup.secondNone: None. Choose a USB stick or another drive, so a dead laptop doesn’t take the event with it.
backup.secondMissing: {{place}} isn't available. Is the USB stick plugged in? Scoring still works, but there's no second copy.
backup.secondSet: Second copy set, and a backup made there.
backup.moveHelp: Saves the whole event, card photos included, as one file to copy to a USB stick. The other laptop checks it's complete as it opens it. Then carry on scoring on that laptop only.
backup.moved: Saved and checked: {{file}} ({{mb}} MB). On the other laptop, choose Open event file… on Home and pick this file.
backup.saveForMove: Save a copy for another laptop…

logos.title: Logos
logos.help: On the results PDF and the big screen. PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB each.
logos.max: Up to {{max}}. Remove one to add another.

sections.intro: Optional. Name the sections and who observed them, and list other officials, to thank them by name at the end of the results.
sections.name: Name or place
sections.thanks: Thank the observers and officials at the end of the results PDF
sections.thanksHelp: Only when any names are entered.

setupProblems.name: Give the event a name.
setupProblems.code: The event code needs 2 to 16 capital letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. SSR3.
setupProblems.firstNumber: First rider number: a whole number from 1 to 9999.
setupProblems.overdue: Overdue after: a whole number of minutes from 5 to 240.
setupProblems.start: Lap 1 start: a time such as 10:15.
setupProblems.noSections: {{label}} rides {{laps}} laps{{day}} but has no sections. Enter the sections, or set laps to 0.
setupProblems.tooMany: {{label}} has {{sections}} sections{{day}}, but the regional card has only 16 rows. Use 16 or fewer.
setupProblems.role: Say what {{name}} did, e.g. Clerk of Course.
setupProblems.officialName: Give the {{role}}'s name, or remove the row.

riders.title: Riders
riders.intro: Change a name, machine, class or competition status, or mark DNS or DNF. Every change is logged.
riders.printNew: Print their card labels: on Card labels, choose “Only labels not printed yet”.
riders.reprintHelp: Their card labels were printed with the old name. On Card labels, choose “One rider (reprint)” and rider {{number}}.
riders.none: No riders yet. Import the entry list: tScore reads Entryplace and Ridernet exports as they come, and the tScore rider list for anything else.
riders.name: Name
riders.nameless: A rider needs a first name or a surname.
riders.secondClassHelp: Only for a rider whose scores also count in another class.
riders.numberProblem: A rider number is a whole number from 1 to 9999.
riders.taken: Rider number {{number}} is already taken. The next free number is {{next}}.
riders.nextFree: The next free number is {{next}}. Numbers already given never change.
riders.sameName: Rider {{number}} already has this name. If it's the same person riding a second class, use Change on rider {{number}} instead.

import.title: Import riders
import.question_one: 1 rider entered “{{raw}}”, which isn't a class in this event. Which class do they ride?
import.question_other: {{count}} riders entered “{{raw}}”, which isn't a class in this event. Which class do they ride?
import.keepAlias: Keep for future events (saved in this event's setup)
import.duplicatesHelp: Often a double entry that was never cleaned up. Sometimes a rider really does ride for a second class.
import.generated: Numbers {{first}}–{{last}}, in class order, then by surname.
import.name: Name
import.already_one: 1 rider already in this event, left as they are
import.already_other: {{count}} riders already in this event, left as they are
import.privacy: Dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, medical and emergency details stay in the entry system. tScore keeps only the name, class, club, machine, licence number and competition status.

picker.noMatch: No rider matches "{{query}}". Check the number, or add them on the Riders screen.

penalty.time: Time (e.g. lap not finished in the time allowed)

manual.saved: Saved rider {{number}} lap {{lap}}: total {{total}}. Next card.
manual.title: Manual entry
manual.intro: Type a card in by hand: when it won't scan, there's no camera, or you'd rather type. Keyboard only: number, <kbd>Enter</kbd>, scores, <kbd>Enter</kbd>. Penalties are added here too.
manual.noRiders: No riders yet. Import the entry list on the Riders screen first.
manual.editing: Editing an earlier card: rider {{number}}, lap {{lap}}. The old scores are kept in the audit log.
manual.inAtHelp: Laptop time. Change for an earlier card.
manual.alreadyIn: Lap {{lap}} for rider {{number}} is already in.
manual.oneDigit: One digit per section ({{values}}). Spaces are ignored.
manual.previewHelp: Fills in as you type. Hold it against the card in your hand: the punches should sit in the same places.
manual.editHelp: Edit loads the card into the form. The old scores, who changed them and when are kept in the audit log.
manual.timeLimit: A section over the 90-second limit isn't a penalty here: it's a 5 on the card, typed with the scores.
manual.penaltiesHelp: Added to the rider's total on the results. Adding or removing one is logged.

scan.start: Choose a camera, or practise with a test card.
scan.place: Place a card on the mat.
scan.noCamera: Couldn't start that camera. Is it plugged in, or used by another program?
scan.toReview_one: Rider {{number}} lap {{lap}}: sent to Review queue (1 to check).
scan.toReview_other: Rider {{number}} lap {{lap}}: sent to Review queue ({{count}} to check).
scan.placeNext: Place the next card on the mat.
scan.cutOff: Move the card into the middle of the mat.
scan.tooSmall: The card is too small in the picture: lower the camera or zoom in.
scan.noLabel: No label: find the rider by number or name.
scan.needsLook: Needs a look: press Enter to send it to the Review queue, or Esc to read it again.
scan.importFirst: Import riders first: practice cards use the first rider on the list.
scan.title: Scan desk
scan.intro: Put each card on the black mat under the camera. Clear cards are saved by themselves; anything unclear goes to the Review queue with its photo.
scan.practiceUnclear: Practice card with an unclear row
scan.noLabelRider: Rider for a card with no label: number or name
scan.extraRows: Punched past the class's sections (row {{rows}}). Check the card and the class.
scan.notListed: Rider {{number}} isn't on the entry list.
scan.laps: Rider {{number}}'s class rides {{laps}} laps on day {{day}}.
scan.alreadyIn: Rider {{number}} lap {{lap}} is already in. To change it, use Manual entry.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Scanned cards with a score the reader couldn't decide. Check the card, pick the score, then save.
review.cantRead: Card can't be read at all? Type it in by hand.
review.label: Rider {{number}}{{name}}, {{class}}, day {{day}} lap {{lap}}

course.progressIntro: Which cards are in, for every rider and lap. Updates as cards are saved, and every 30 seconds.
course.overdueTitle: Overdue: no card for more than {{minutes}} minutes past their class's average lap
course.overdueLine: Rider {{number}} ({{name}}, {{class}}): no lap {{lap}} card after {{after}}. {{class}} laps average {{average}}.
course.notFlagged: Not flagged: {{list}}, so their next card isn't due until that many laps' time has passed. Overdue never marks anyone DNF by itself.
course.noRiders: No riders yet. Import the entry list on the Riders screen.
course.noFilter: No riders to show with this filter.
course.key: Key: number = lap total · … = a section still undecided · Late = overdue (margin set in Event setup) · DNF = did not finish · DNS = did not start · blank = not in yet · grey = not ridden by this class.
course.onCourseIntro: Worked out from the cards in and riders marked DNF. A rider is on course from the start until their final lap card is in, or they're marked DNF.
course.startsAt: Lap 1 starts at {{time}}. Riders are on course from then.
course.allAccounted: Everyone is accounted for. The event can be closed down.
course.closeEvent: Close the event: check and mark results final
course.boardKey: Red = on course · Green = final card in · Grey = DNF or did not start

results.title: Results
results.intro: Worked out from every card in so far. Updates as cards are saved.
results.none: No riders yet. Import the entry list on the Riders screen, then type or scan cards.
results.key: NA = No award: scored and ranked among themselves, never placed. NC = Non-competitive: listed after the class with their counts only; their scores are never shown or published. Penalties are added on the Manual entry page.
results.initials: Show junior riders' surnames as an initial (“Riley M.”)
results.juniorClasses: Junior classes here: {{classes}}. Applies to the PDF and CSV. Results on this laptop always show full names.
results.noJuniors: The PDF and CSV show what's on screen. Non-competitive riders' scores are never included.
results.allInHelp: No card is missing and no score is waiting. Check the results, then save the PDF.
results.markedFinal: Marked final {{when}}. Saved PDFs and CSVs say FINAL. Cards, penalties, riders and the setup can't change until the results are reopened.
results.reopenHelp: Say what needs correcting. The reason is logged, and printed on the next revision along with any places that change.
results.why: Why are the results being reopened?
results.whyPlaceholder: e.g. Rider 12, lap 3 section 6: observer card misread, 3 not 5
results.noChanges: No places have changed since revision {{revision}} yet.
results.whenConfirmed: When the results are confirmed, mark them final.
results.whenConfirmedRevision: When the results are confirmed, mark them final as revision {{revision}}.
results.notYet: Results can be marked final once every expected card is in.
results.markHelp: Saved PDFs and CSVs will say FINAL. Cards, penalties, riders and the setup can't change until you reopen the results, with a reason.

testTrial.title: Test trial check
testTrial.read: Your setup read {{right}} of {{cards}} cards correctly.
testTrial.ready: Your laptop, camera and printer are ready for an event.

live.title: Live scores
live.waiting: Waiting for the results desk to open an event.
live.secondScreen: Showing full screen on the second screen.
live.noSecond: No second screen found: drag the window to the TV, then press F11 for full screen.

series.title: Series points
series.intro: A points tally across the rounds of a series, worked out from each round's final results.
series.name: Series name
series.detailIntro: Series points. Only rounds with final results count.
series.noRounds: No rounds yet. Add each round's event.
series.addFromEvents: Add a round from your events
series.pointsError: Whole numbers, highest first, separated by commas.
series.split: Split: most round wins, then latest round
series.rulesHelp: DNF and No award score 0 for the round. A round not ridden is blank. Non-competitive riders take no series points. Riders are matched by name in each class.

labels.noLaps: has no laps in the event setup
labels.title: Card labels
labels.intro: One sticky label per rider for each lap their class rides. Stick it on the card's header, above the grid.
labels.unprintedHelp: Late entries, and laps added since the last print
labels.startAtHelp: Use up a sheet that's already been started
labels.qrHelp: The scan desk reads the rider and lap from it
labels.mindersHelp: Minders aren't scored. Untick to print their labels.
labels.printHelp: Open it in Microsoft Word and print at 100% (actual size), on the label sheets.
labels.previewHelp: Dashed outlines show the label edges; they don't print. Grey labels are skipped.
labels.printedBefore: {{printed}} labels printed before; {{notPrinted}} not printed yet.
labels.alignSaved: Saved for this laptop. Labels saved from now on use it.
labels.alignHelp: Once per printer: print the test page on plain paper, hold it against a label sheet up to the light, and measure how far the outlines are off.
labels.none: No labels to print with these settings.

manage.title: Manage events
manage.intro: Every event on this laptop and the space it uses. Tidy up old ones: remove their card scans (a small copy of each card is kept), or delete the whole event to the {{bin}}.
manage.none: No events on this laptop yet.
manage.keepLabel: Keep {{name}}: don't offer it for tidying
manage.removed_one: Card scans removed: 1 photo shrunk to small copies, {{size}} freed.
manage.removed_other: Card scans removed: {{count}} photos shrunk to small copies, {{size}} freed.
manage.deleted_one: 1 event moved to the {{bin}}. Restore from there if it was a mistake.
manage.deleted_other: {{count}} events moved to the {{bin}}. Restore from there if it was a mistake.
manage.removeIntroOne: Card photos for {{name}} ({{size}}) are shrunk to small copies.
manage.removeIntroMany: Card photos for {{count}} events ({{size}}) are shrunk to small copies.
manage.kept: Kept: riders, every score, the audit log, results (PDF, CSV) and backups. Results can still be reopened and revised.
manage.lost: Lost: the full-size photos. Scores stay, but if a result is questioned you'll only have a small copy of the card to look at.
manage.notFinal_one: {{names}} hasn't had results marked final. Mark them final first if you can.
manage.notFinal_other: {{names}} haven't had results marked final. Mark them final first if you can.
manage.deleteIntro: The whole event folder goes to the {{bin}}: riders, every score, card photos, results and the event's own backups. Until the bin is emptied it can be put back from there. Backups on a second place (USB) aren't touched.
manage.backupFrom: Backup on the second place from {{when}}.
manage.noBackup: No backup found on the second place.
manage.noSecondSetUp: No second place for backups is set up.
manage.typeCode: To confirm, type the event's code: {{code}}
manage.typeCount: To confirm, type how many events: {{count}}

check.title: Pre-event check
check.intro: Run this when you arrive at the venue, before the first card comes in.
check.camera: The camera check comes with scanning.

suggest.email: Your mail app should now be open with the suggestion in it. Check it, then send.
suggest.emailAndClipboard: It was too long to fit in an email link, so it’s on the clipboard: paste it into the email (Ctrl+V), then send.
suggest.clipboard: Copied. Paste it into an email to {{email}}, or a message.
suggest.file: Saved. Email it later, or hand it to someone who can.
suggest.title: Suggest a feature
suggest.intro: Works without internet. Nothing is sent from tScore: email it, copy it, or save it to send later. tScore adds its version, the Windows version and the screen you were on, never event or rider details. Questions marked * are needed.
suggest.answerFirst: Please answer the questions marked * first.
